ZONINGLOT DEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (Agreement") dated as 1 between MURMAC MANAGEMENT COMPANY LLC, a New York limited liability company having an office c/o Stephen Frank Associates, Inc., 2601 South Bayshore Drive, Penthouse - 1A, Miami, Florida 33133 ("Murmac"), and NEW HAMPTON, LLC, a limited liability company having an office at 158 West 58t Street, New York, New York 10019 ("Hampton"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Murmac is the owner of (i) certain volume of air (the“Volume") in the City of New York (the “City"), and more particularly described in Schedule “A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof, and (i) the Excess Floor Area Development Rights (hereinafter defined); and WHEREAS, Hampton is the owner of certain land, (the“Land") in the City of New York (the “City"), and the buildings and improvements thereon located (the“Building"), located at 158West58thStreet,NewYork,NewYork,and known as Block 1010,Lot 55on the Tax Map (the “Tax Map") of the City and more particularly described in Schedule“B” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land, together with the Building being herein referred to as the “Land and the Building": the Land and the Building and the Volume are hereinafter referred to collectively as the “Property"); WHEREAS, all parties in interest (as defined in the Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (hereinafter defined)) to the Property as shown on the Zoning Lot Certification of First American Title Insurance Company, annexed hereto as Schedule C, have joined in this Agreement or have subordinated theretoand such subordinations are attached heretoin Schedule D; NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing, Murmac and Hampton hereby agree asfollows: (1) Certain Definitions. As used herein: （a)"ExcessFloorAreaDevelopmentRights”shallmeanthatportionof Utilized Floor Area Development Rights. (b)“Floor Area Development Rights”shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the ZoningResolution of the City of NewYork,effective as of December 15, 1961, as amended from time to time (the “Zoning Resolution"),which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop the zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined (i) by multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district or districts in which such zoning lot is located, -2- 407226-4

and (i) by the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution, including non-complying floor area, bulk or density rights, pertaining to such zoning lot and which may be authorized to be developed by the appropriate agency of the City from time to time. (c) “Floor area”, “floor area ratio”", “lot coverage”", “dwelling unit”, terms are capitalized herein) shall have the meanings set forth in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution. (d)“Utilized Floor Area Development Rights”shall mean the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to the Property utilized by the buildings and improvements located thereon asof the dateof thisAgreement. (2)Waiver. Hampton hereby (A) waives any and all rights, title and interest, and benefit it may have, and acknowledges that Murmac retains any and all right, title, interest and benefit, in the Excess Floor Area Development Rights, (B) waives any rights Hampton may have to sign a declaration of zoning lot restrictions with respect to the Property, (C) agrees not to execute and deliver any instruments, applications, subordinations or documents (including, without limitation, all amendments, modifications, additions, replacements, restatements or consolidations thereto) giving effect to, needed to give effect to, relating to, or in connection with, in any manner, directly or indirectly, the foregoing (A), (B), and (C), and (E) grants an irrevocable power of attorney, coupled with an interest, with full power of substitution, to Murmac to execute, deliver and record any such instrument, application or document to the extent Hampton is required hereunder to execute and deliver such instrument, application or document and Hampton does not so execute and deliver such instrument, application or document to Murmac within ten (10) days after request by Murmac . (3)Utilization of Excess Floor Area Development Rights; Cooperation. Hampton shall not at any time voluntarily appear, or authorize anyone to appear on its behalf, in opposition to Murmac (or its designee) in any action or hearing brought, sought or defended the City of New York,the Department of Buildings of the City of New York, the Board of Standards andAppeals of the City of NewYork or any other agency of the City or any state or federal agency, arising out of, relating to, or in connection with, in any manner, directly or indirectly, any zoning or variance applications relating to the Property, the zoning lot in which the Property is now or hereafter located, or the use, conveyance, assignment or transfer of the ExcessFloorAreaDevelopmentRights.
